design.screening: Round robin over all 10 unique source hashes; every unordered pair; both seats; same fixed seeds for every pair.
design.confirmation: After screening, final two compete against each other and all eight non-finalists on a fresh matched seed panel, both seats; report holdout-only estimates.
design.primary: Average match points / win probability with ties worth half; coin margin and terminal cash are secondary.
design.safety: Record terminal status, exceptions, invalid-action telemetry when exposed, total runtime, callback count, p95/max callback latency; no Kaggle submissions.
